description:
A stylish purpose built apartment with allocated parking located on this popular development set in attractive communal grounds enjoying riverside views.
 Comment from the seller - “I've absolutely loved living in this flat. It has such great natural light, even in winter. The location has been fantastic: the surroundings are peaceful, green and leafy, yet you can be in town in 20 minutes”.

Constructed in 2004 this top floor property offers a pleasing dual aspect living/dining room with French doors and Juliet balcony providing an airy feel complimented by natural light. In addition there is a modern fitted kitchen with a range of base units and matching eye level wall cupboards, a built in oven and washing machine. There are 2 double bedrooms, the master benefitting from a built in wardrobe, both served by a family bathroom with white suite and ceramic tiling.

Leander Way is positioned off the Abingdon Road approx. 1.5 miles from the city centre with many regular and direct bus services to its superb range of shops, restaurants and bars. The River Thames and Iffley Meadows are a short distance away, with a towpath leading right into the centre of Oxford. For those who need access out of town, the ring road is just a few minutes drive providing links to Birmingham and London via the M40.

Leasehold - 125 years starting 1 Jan 2004 
Service Charge: c. £1,500 pa 
Ground Rent: £275 pa
Council Tax Band: D
keyFeatures: Dual Aspect 19 Ft (max) Living Room with Juliet Balcony
Primary Bedroom with Built in Wardrobes
Desirable South Oxford Location with Excellent Transport Links
